made_before: any V0.4 model was fit or any V0.4 score was computed (development or test)
information_used: partition sizes and the label composition of cross-episode sample overlaps only (no feature-label association, no score)
registered_rule: independence unit = temporal episode + positives < 2 km + ANY two samples of different groups < 400 m; dev/test purge if ANY sample of a test group is < 1 km from ANY development sample
problem: Transitive chaining through control-control overlaps merged almost all temporal episodes into one block, leaving a 4-event test. Controls overlapping controls carry the same label (pseudo-negative) and transmit no label information across partitions.
amended_rule: location links and the 1 km dev/test purge use only sample pairs in which at least one sample is a positive (positive-positive and positive-control). Positives < 2 km on any dates remain linked. Everything else unchanged.
residual_risk: Test controls may lie near development controls (same label). Tree models could in principle memorise such locations; linear models cannot exploit identity. Reported as a limitation.
